主要内容: SouthCorp Capital, Inc. announced in its Form 8-K filing dated February 9, 2015, that it had begun discussions with Nate’s Food Co. in November 2014 to build a factory in Indiana with a capacity to manufacture 50-100 million cans per year. The company currently owns industrial and commercial property in Indiana that will be used as the site for the factory and storage. As part of these discussions, SouthCorp agreed to purchase equipment for Nate’s Food’s Fairfield, California location for approximately $400,000 in exchange for a per can sold fee. The equipment will be part of the planned expansion of the facilities in Fairfield, California while the Indiana factory is built.
